card.name: Closing bracket after section cross-references
card.fires_on: The closing parenthesis after a section number such as (2.1) or (4) in the highlights of a drug label, where the number points to the full section. Also fires weakly on a few sentence ends and web page phrases.

modes.label: Section number closing
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a numbered cross-reference at the end of a dosing statement or contraindication.
